191.name: Sunkern
191.flavor_text: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

192.name: Sunflora
192.flavor_text: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

193.name: Yanma
193.flavor_text: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

194.name: Wooper
194.flavor_text: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

195.name: Quagsire
195.flavor_text: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

196.name: Espeon
196.flavor_text: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

197.name: Umbreon
197.flavor_text: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

198.name: Murkrow
198.flavor_text: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

199.name: Slowking
199.flavor_text: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

200.name: Misdreavus
200.flavor_text: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

201.name: Unown
201.flavor_text: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

202.name: Wobbuffet
202.flavor_text: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

203.name: Girafarig
203.flavor_text: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

204.name: Pineco
204.flavor_text: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

205.name: Forretress
205.flavor_text: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

206.name: Dunsparce
206.flavor_text: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

207.name: Gligar
207.flavor_text: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

208.name: Steelix
208.flavor_text: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

209.name: Snubbull
209.flavor_text: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

210.name: Granbull
210.flavor_text: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

211.name: Qwilfish
211.flavor_text: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

212.name: Scizor
212.flavor_text: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

213.name: Shuckle
213.flavor_text: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

214.name: Heracross
214.flavor_text: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

215.name: Sneasel
215.flavor_text: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

216.name: Teddiursa
216.flavor_text: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

217.name: Ursaring
217.flavor_text: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

218.name: Slugma
218.flavor_text: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

219.name: Magcargo
219.flavor_text: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

220.name: Swinub
220.flavor_text: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

221.name: Piloswine
221.flavor_text: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

222.name: Corsola
222.flavor_text: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

223.name: Remoraid
223.flavor_text: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

224.name: Octillery
224.flavor_text: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

225.name: Delibird
225.flavor_text: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

226.name: Mantine
226.flavor_text: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

227.name: Skarmory
227.flavor_text: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

228.name: Houndour
228.flavor_text: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

229.name: Houndoom
229.flavor_text: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

230.name: Kingdra
230.flavor_text: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

231.name: Phanpy
231.flavor_text: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

232.name: Donphan
232.flavor_text: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

233.name: Porygon2
233.flavor_text: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

234.name: Stantler
234.flavor_text: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

235.name: Smeargle
235.flavor_text: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

236.name: Tyrogue
236.flavor_text: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

237.name: Hitmontop
237.flavor_text: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

238.name: Smoochum
238.flavor_text: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

239.name: Elekid
239.flavor_text: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

240.name: Magby
240.flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

241.name: Miltank
241.flavor_text: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

242.name: Blissey
242.flavor_text: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

243.name: Raikou
243.flavor_text: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

244.name: Entei
244.flavor_text: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

245.name: Suicune
245.flavor_text: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

246.name: Larvitar
246.flavor_text: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

247.name: Pupitar
247.flavor_text: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

248.name: Tyranitar
248.flavor_text: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

249.name: Lugia
249.flavor_text: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

250.name: Ho Oh
250.flavor_text: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

251.name: Celebi
251.flavor_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

252.name: Treecko
252.flavor_text: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

253.name: Grovyle
253.flavor_text: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

254.name: Sceptile
254.flavor_text: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

255.name: Torchic
255.flavor_text: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

256.name: Combusken
256.flavor_text: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

257.name: Blaziken
257.flavor_text: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

258.name: Mudkip
258.flavor_text: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

259.name: Marshtomp
259.flavor_text: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

260.name: Swampert
260.flavor_text: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

261.name: Poochyena
261.flavor_text: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

262.name: Mightyena
262.flavor_text: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

263.name: Zigzagoon
263.flavor_text: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

264.name: Linoone
264.flavor_text: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

265.name: Wurmple
265.flavor_text: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

266.name: Silcoon
266.flavor_text: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

267.name: Beautifly
267.flavor_text: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

268.name: Cascoon
268.flavor_text: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

269.name: Dustox
269.flavor_text: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

270.name: Lotad
270.flavor_text: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

271.name: Lombre
271.flavor_text: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

272.name: Ludicolo
272.flavor_text: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

273.name: Seedot
273.flavor_text: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

274.name: Nuzleaf
274.flavor_text: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

275.name: Shiftry
275.flavor_text: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

276.name: Taillow
276.flavor_text: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.

277.name: Swellow
277.flavor_text: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

278.name: Wingull
278.flavor_text: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

279.name: Pelipper
279.flavor_text: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

280.name: Ralts
280.flavor_text: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

281.name: Kirlia
281.flavor_text: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

282.name: Gardevoir
282.flavor_text: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

283.name: Surskit
283.flavor_text: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

284.name: Masquerain
284.flavor_text: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

285.name: Shroomish
285.flavor_text: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

286.name: Breloom
286.flavor_text: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

287.name: Slakoth
287.flavor_text: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

288.name: Vigoroth
288.flavor_text: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.

289.name: Slaking
289.flavor_text: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.

290.name: Nincada
290.flavor_text: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

291.name: Ninjask
291.flavor_text: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

292.name: Shedinja
292.flavor_text: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

293.name: Whismur
293.flavor_text: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

294.name: Loudred
294.flavor_text: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

295.name: Exploud
295.flavor_text: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

296.name: Makuhita
296.flavor_text: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

297.name: Hariyama
297.flavor_text: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

298.name: Azurill
298.flavor_text: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

299.name: Nosepass
299.flavor_text: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

300.name: Skitty
300.flavor_text: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.

301.name: Delcatty
301.flavor_text: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.

302.name: Sableye
302.flavor_text: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

303.name: Mawile
303.flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

304.name: Aron
304.flavor_text: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

305.name: Lairon
305.flavor_text: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

306.name: Aggron
306.flavor_text: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

307.name: Meditite
307.flavor_text: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

308.name: Medicham
308.flavor_text: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

309.name: Electrike
309.flavor_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

310.name: Manectric
310.flavor_text: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

311.name: Plusle
311.flavor_text: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

312.name: Minun
312.flavor_text: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

313.name: Volbeat
313.flavor_text: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

314.name: Illumise
314.flavor_text: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

315.name: Roselia
315.flavor_text: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

316.name: Gulpin
316.flavor_text: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

317.name: Swalot
317.flavor_text: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.

318.name: Carvanha
318.flavor_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

319.name: Sharpedo
319.flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

320.name: Wailmer
320.flavor_text: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

321.name: Wailord
321.flavor_text: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

322.name: Numel
322.flavor_text: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

323.name: Camerupt
323.flavor_text: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

324.name: Torkoal
324.flavor_text: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

325.name: Spoink
325.flavor_text: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

326.name: Grumpig
326.flavor_text: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

327.name: Spinda
327.flavor_text: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

328.name: Trapinch
328.flavor_text: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

329.name: Vibrava
329.flavor_text: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

330.name: Flygon
330.flavor_text: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

331.name: Cacnea
331.flavor_text: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

332.name: Cacturne
332.flavor_text: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.

333.name: Swablu
333.flavor_text: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

334.name: Altaria
334.flavor_text: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

335.name: Zangoose
335.flavor_text: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

336.name: Seviper
336.flavor_text: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

337.name: Lunatone
337.flavor_text: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

338.name: Solrock
338.flavor_text: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

339.name: Barboach
339.flavor_text: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

340.name: Whiscash
340.flavor_text: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

341.name: Corphish
341.flavor_text: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

342.name: Crawdaunt
342.flavor_text: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

343.name: Baltoy
343.flavor_text: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

344.name: Claydol
344.flavor_text: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

345.name: Lileep
345.flavor_text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

346.name: Cradily
346.flavor_text: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

347.name: Anorith
347.flavor_text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

348.name: Armaldo
348.flavor_text: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

349.name: Feebas
349.flavor_text: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

350.name: Milotic
350.flavor_text: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

351.name: Castform
351.flavor_text: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

352.name: Kecleon
352.flavor_text: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

353.name: Shuppet
353.flavor_text: There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

354.name: Banette
354.flavor_text: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

355.name: Duskull
355.flavor_text: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

356.name: Dusclops
356.flavor_text: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

357.name: Tropius
357.flavor_text: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

358.name: Chimecho
358.flavor_text: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

359.name: Absol
359.flavor_text: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

360.name: Wynaut
360.flavor_text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

361.name: Snorunt
361.flavor_text: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

362.name: Glalie
362.flavor_text: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

363.name: Spheal
363.flavor_text: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

364.name: Sealeo
364.flavor_text: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

365.name: Walrein
365.flavor_text: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

366.name: Clamperl
366.flavor_text: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

367.name: Huntail
367.flavor_text: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

368.name: Gorebyss
368.flavor_text: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

369.name: Relicanth
369.flavor_text: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

370.name: Luvdisc
370.flavor_text: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

371.name: Bagon
371.flavor_text: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

372.name: Shelgon
372.flavor_text: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

373.name: Salamence
373.flavor_text: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

374.name: Beldum
374.flavor_text: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

375.name: Metang
375.flavor_text: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

376.name: Metagross
376.flavor_text: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

377.name: Regirock
377.flavor_text: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

378.name: Regice
378.flavor_text: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

379.name: Registeel
379.flavor_text: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

380.name: Latias
380.flavor_text: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

381.name: Latios
381.flavor_text: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

382.name: Kyogre
382.flavor_text: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

383.name: Groudon
383.flavor_text: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

384.name: Rayquaza
384.flavor_text: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.
